sentences.text: Exploring a research collaboration on SHOC2-related Mazzanti syndrome
We are writing to the Noonan Syndrome Foundation, and would also value the views of the RASopathies Network.
SHOC2-related Mazzanti syndrome is linked to gain of function.
PATRAS and the RASopathies Network contact registry include people with this condition.
A clinical, genetic and epidemiologic study of RASopathies is recruiting.
A cardiomyopathy natural history study is also recruiting, though it enrols by syndrome and does not name SHOC2.
Our atlas lists no treatment trial specific to this condition.
We would like to explore a jointly designed study on Mazzanti syndrome, shaped with your community from the start: [study question], [design], [sites].
Any participation would follow informed consent and ethics approval, and we would share what we learn with your community.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be open to a conversation about whether this idea is useful to the families you serve?
If so, we would value your view on how your community, registry or natural history work could take part, with proper consent and ethics approval.
We are not asking for any personal information about patients or families.
Could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you, perhaps [proposed dates]?
With thanks and warm regards, [researcher name], [institution].
